svg.title: Star and Shadow Cinema — Ground Floor Plan
svg.desc: Colour-coded ground floor plan of the Star and Shadow Cinema, Warwick Street, Newcastle upon Tyne. Rooms are coloured by type: Cinema (red), Venue (blue), Café (amber), and related/functional spaces in thematic pastels. Tenant spaces (Flea Circus, Blank Studios) are shown with a crosshatch pattern.
